title: Policies, Procedures, and Forms Updates — IMM Revision: Individual Country Listing for Comoros
why: Q2: records La Poste Comores' UPU request and a new 5-digit postcode required on all mail to Comoros from 15 October 2026; postal use, not a street-address register.

title: Aménagement du territoire et urbanisme : Un processus d'adressage et annuaire officiellement lancé
why: Q1: reports launch of an addressing and directory process to number houses and name streets, starting in Ngazidja then Ndzuani and Mwali, completion targeted end-2023.

title: Le Ministre des Télécommunications envisage d'instaurer des codes postaux aux Comores pour favoriser le développement
why: Q1: states Comoros had no structured addressing system or postcodes at the time and the minister intends to introduce them; describes possible postal and emergency benefits.

title: General Addressing Issues
why: Q2: UPU August 2026 listing still shows Comoros among countries not requiring postal codes; status check against the later USPS notice.

title: Collectivités locales / 13 agents formés sur l'étude urbaine et communale
why: Q1: reports training for a domiciliary-addressing process and address book, first operation planned in Ngazidja/Moroni; background only, predates the three-year window.
